subject: AstroNova marketplace bundle — commit request and channel margin clarification
messages:
From: Sarah Young <sarah.young@astronova.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AstroNova - marketplace bundle pricing & commit ask

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking the time on the demo last week. AstroNova is evaluating a pilot that will run primarily on Azure and we'd like to structure a private offer via the Azure Marketplace rather than a direct invoice — procurement needs the marketplace route for compliance.

High-level ask:
- Target commit (12 months): $450k consumption across reserved + metered SKU mix
- Requested headline discount vs list: 27% (we understand this is aggressive)
- Channel/reseller: we plan to onboard NorthStar Consulting as our integrator and they require a minimum 12% reseller margin to make the deal economics work.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether Redwood will support a private offer with a 27% discount and a 12% reseller pass-through on Azure?
2) If not, what packaging/anchoring options you can propose so we can hit AstroNova's net spend target while preserving NorthStar's margin?
3) Any evidence or prior examples of invoice path and reseller pass-through mechanics for Azure marketplace private offers — procurement will want to see flow diagrams or sample invoice routing.

I've attached our short RFP and a usage profile. If we can align on structure, we aim to get an LOI from Finance by the end of the month.

Attachments: AstroNova_RFP_Q2.pdf (usage profile, procurement checklist)

Thanks,
Sarah Young
Senior Procurement Manager | AstroNova
+sarah.young@astronova.io
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Young <sarah.young@astronova.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AstroNova - marketplace bundle pricing & commit ask

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and the deck. Quick answers up front: we can do a marketplace private offer on Azure and support reseller pass-through, but the economics will need a packaging approach so the platform and partner both meet their targets.

Initial thoughts:
- 27% off list + 12% reseller pass-through is tight for a $450k commit on current SKUs. We can propose two paths:
  1) Adjust list (anchor) for the private offer — increase published list by a margin that allows a 27% headline discount while preserving ~10–12% partner margin. This keeps AstroNova's net similar but gives the partner room.
  2) Keep published list, reduce headline discount to ~22% and add a fixed implementation credit (one-time) to reach AstroNova's effective net spend. That preserves per-token economics.

I can run a quick model if you can share the expected SKU mix (reserved node vs metered). I cc'ed Olga for marketplace invoice path details and Ben for channel/commissioning impact.

Next steps:
- Olga: can you attach the Azure pass-through flow diagram and a sample private-offer line-item template we can share with procurement?
- Ben: can you confirm what minimum commission tier we can support programmatically (10% vs 12%) and if there's flexibility for a $X implementation top-up?

Sarah — will follow up with a short matrix showing net to AstroNova vs partner margin and a recommended packaging by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
